title: Property
description: A property (e.g., hotel, rental property) location.

type.description: Property family, as stated by the Business. Well-known values: `hotel` (hotels, resort hotels, suite or apartment hotels, motels), `hostel`, `short_term_rental` (furnished units let for short stays, such as holiday homes, apartments, villas), `campground` (camping grounds, recreational vehicle parks, trailer parks), `bed_and_breakfast`, `other`. Businesses MAY use additional values. Platforms MUST treat an unrecognized value as unclassified and MUST NOT infer the value from other fields.

media.description: Property media (images, videos, 3D models). First item is the featured media for presentation.
